title: Game News Round-Up
summary: Daily curated games-industry news digest for 29 September 2026.

items.title: Konami has confirmed tour dates and pre-order times for an upcoming series of **Castlevania** concerts designed to celebrate the series’ 40th anniversary
bullets: The show, which is titled Castlevania 40th Anniversary: An Orchestral Concert, will take place in three locations around the world in March 2027

bullets.text: It will be performed by a 25-piece “power rock orchestra” and will be synchronised with gameplay footage being shown on screens

bullets: The show’s first performance will take place on March 13, 2027 at the Tokyo Opera City Concert Hall, Tokyo

bullets.text: The second performance takes place the next day on March 14, 2027 at the Eventim Apollo, London
The run ends on March 26, 2027 at the Dolby Theatre, Los Angeles, with tickets set to go on sale on October 1 at 10am PT

items.title: **Call of Duty: Warzone** will soon make it possible to toggle visibility of previous Call of Duty skins
bullets: Infinity Ward has previously stated that Modern Warfare 4 and future collaborations will be taking an "authentic" and "grounded" approach to skins
This comes after backlash online over more cartoony / stlized skins in previous Call of Duty games, such as American Dad, Beavis and Butt-Head .etc.

items.title: **Persona 3** Series Surpasses 5 Million Sales, **Persona 4** Series Surpasses 5.7 Million Sales
bullets: Persona 3 series includes Persona 3, Persona 3 FES, Persona 3 Portable, Persona 3 Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 3 Reload
Persona 4 series includes Persona 4, Persona 4 Golden, Persona 4 Arena, Persona 4 Arena Ultimax and Persona 4 Dancing All Night
Regionally, 40% of series sales are from North America, 20% are from Japan, 20% are from Europe and 20% are from Asia

items.title: Enad Global 7 announces staff reduction at **Cold Iron Studios** (developers behind Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2)
